experiment: P0 FRONTIER cross-family: core decay curve + boundary-compression moat + faithful floor lever on two frontier API models (round-6 gap: all three existing families are 7B-class open models).

models.openai/gpt-5.4-mini: recent (2026-03) OpenAI model run with reasoning_effort='none' + temperature=0, i.e. NON-reasoning mode, matching the plain greedy-summarization regime of every other family

design: framing_sweep.py with conds=handoff,longctx,verbatim,faithful (+auto nofact); n=100 facts, M=8, budget=25, ks=0,1,2,4,8, seed=0, level=actionable, current (boundary) grader. Identical protocol/prompts/cache scheme as the Qwen/Mistral/Phi runs; only the backend differs.

answers_three_questions.Q1_does_tau_exist_at_frontier: handoff decays at all under M=8@25 pressure
answers_three_questions.Q2_does_the_moat_replicate: handoff drop >> longctx drop at matched tokens; verbatim near-flat
answers_three_questions.Q3_does_the_floor_lever_transfer: faithful sits above handoff at deep k (S4-gap estimand, matching round-6 practice; fitted floors on 5-pt grids reported but not load-bearing)

PRE-REGISTERED GATES (per model).G1_decay_exists: handoff S(0) - S(8) >= 0.20. PASS -> tau_h is not a small-open-model artifact. FAIL -> run the pre-registered escalation (budget=12 and/or M=16) to re-enter the decay regime; 'frontier tau is longer' folds into the scaling narrative and is NOT a paper failure.
PRE-REGISTERED GATES (per model).G2_moat: (handoff drop) - (longctx drop) >= 0.20 AND verbatim S(8) >= 0.90. PASS -> boundary-compression moat holds at frontier. FAIL on a decaying model -> moat is scale-limited; must be scoped honestly (most damaging outcome; judged unlikely given 3/3 open families).
PRE-REGISTERED GATES (per model).G3_floor_lever: faithful S(4) - handoff S(4) >= 0.10 (also report the S(8) gap). PASS -> Moat-2 lever transfers to frontier. FAIL while G1 passes -> stance lever is scale-limited; scope statement.

predictions.sonnet: decays but slower than 7B-class (tau ~2-6 vs Qwen ~1.5); moat replicates (longctx drop <= 0.10); faithful S4 gap +0.10..0.35
predictions.gpt54mini: similar or slightly weaker retention than sonnet; same qualitative pattern
predictions.biggest_risk: G1 FAIL on one or both (frontier models may keep all 8 facts under a 25-word budget by aggressive enumeration) -> escalation path pre-registered above; second risk: budget-overflow behavior differs (frontier models may ignore the word budget), so report mean carry length vs budget (slack) alongside

honest_notes: API decoding is best-effort deterministic (temperature=0); provider-side nondeterminism possible; cache stores the first sample, so all analyses are internally consistent.
gpt-5.4-mini is evaluated in non-reasoning mode by design; reasoning-mode handoff behavior is a separate question, out of scope here.
Cost estimate ~USD 20 (sonnet) + ~USD 2 (gpt-5.4-mini), ~5500 generations per model, serial.
planned_next_if_pass: P1 = DROPWATCH gate + N2 natural chain on the cheaper frontier model; P2 = E1 externality.
